description: Goldie is a design strategist for print-on-demand sellers. Analyze a bestseller to see why it sells, turn those ingredients into fresh original concepts, expand one design into a full product line, generate market-ready phrases for your niche, surface emerging trends, and map crossover niches for your shop. Goldie can also check whether a design file is print-ready. It is built to help you create original, commercially-minded designs faster.

defaultPrompt: Show me Goldie's modes and help me choose the right one
Give me Golden Phrases for book lovers in a nostalgic tone
Use Gold Radar to find emerging print-on-demand opportunities this week
